description: The user's library, newest first: model_id, name, preview and what was saved with each model (print checks with their verdict, crafts, game packs), plus generations in progress. search finds a model by name; has_output finds the one prepared for printing or for a craft. Free.

has_output.description: Only models with a saved output of this kind, most recent first: print (a print check), papercraft, laser, bricks, flexi, game_pack or any

limit.description: How many models to return (1–20, default 10)

search.description: Part of a model name to look for

name: list_models
title: List my 3D models
